msg: hey! we're 4 uni students from the UK backpacking colombia, on a tight budget lol. none of us has dived. whats the cheapest way to try diving? we're staying at a hostel in getsemani
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. 🌊

Trying diving for the first time in the Rosario Islands is a brilliant way to experience the reef. It’s a one-day trip from Cartagena with theory, pool practice, and one ocean dive with an instructor—no experience or certification needed. Equipment, boat transport, and lunch are included.

The group discount is *10% for groups of 5 or more*, so it doesn’t apply to a group of four. You’ll meet at *Muelle de la Bodeguita at 8:00 a.m.*; getting to the dock from your hostel isn’t included.

Book the Dive Mini Course: https://book.divingplanet.org/book/minicurso-de-buceo/2?language=en 🐠

*Prices per person* (online · regular):
• Dive Mini Course: 183 USD · 204 USD
• Snorkeling Tour: 126 USD · 140 USD

Without a certification, the *mini-course* is the ideal way to dive: no experience needed and you go with an instructor. To enjoy the reef from the surface there's *snorkeling*, and to get certified, the *PADI Open Water course*. Which one interests you? 🤿

msg: mini course for all 4 then! can each of us pay separately with our own card? and is there a student discount? we want to go this saturday

Perfect! The Dive Mini Course is a great first experience for all four of you. International guests pay 100% by card on the website, but I don’t have confirmation on whether each person can pay separately with their own card.

There’s no student discount listed. The 10% online discount is applied automatically when booking directly through our website. The 10% group discount is for groups of 5 or more, so it doesn’t apply to your group of four.
